method.appearance: RGB thumbnail <=256px; L mean/std and HSV saturation, 0..255
method.mixture: equal image weight within each domain; per-box weights split across each positive image; inverse empirical CDF
method.within_scene: p90/p10 of max normalized box side for images with >=2 boxes
method.coverage: sum of bbox areas, overlaps counted repeatedly; not fruit mask coverage
method.size_960: sqrt box area after aspect-preserving longest-side resize to 960; excludes padding
